Lead source: inbound signup + demo request from growth engineer (Ben R.)

Initial impression: lean engineering team building an in-app assistant for their product; very latency-sensitive — want responses streaming into the client UI with sub-200ms tail for short turns. Interested in hosted API for self-serve to avoid infra ops.

Quotes from call:
- "We need streaming with token-level events for our web widget; users abandon if reply takes >1s"
- "Cost matters — this is a freemium product, growth at scale could mean lots of short sessions"

Technical constraints / preferences:
- Mostly public cloud usage (AWS us-east primary)
- Prefer Redwood-managed hosted API rather than Dedicated for now
- Want SDK examples for streaming (JS + mobile) and a replayable Fireflies transcript
- Model preference: mid-sized open model that supports streaming and fast decode; quantized variants OK if quality preserved

Security: ask for SOC2 cert, audit logs, SSO for internal tooling. Data retention policy questions from legal (30/90/retain on request).

Commercial: small ARR expected first 12 months; set expectations on unit economics and recommended Optimize settings for prefix caching and batching. Engineering team asked for a rough monthly cost estimate for 100k short chat completions (avg 30 tokens out).

Sales notes: good fit for Hosted API self-serve; potential to expand to Optimize suggestions. Timeline: wants POC in 2–3 weeks and decision before end of April.
